about:
# Yatlas

Yet another atlas: a World of Warcraft addon that shows the whole world at minimap detail.

Yatlas builds its maps from the game's minimap terrain tiles, not from the illustrated world map. The result is a seamless top-down view of each continent that you can zoom, with the same terrain, roads and coastlines you see on your minimap.

## Supported clients

| Client | Status |
|---|---|
| **Retail (Midnight, 12.1.5)** | Supported from v1.0.0 |
| **Mists of Pandaria Classic (5.5.4)** | Supported from v0.9.4 |
| **Anniversary / Burning Crusade (2.5.6)** | Supported from v1.0.0 |
| **Classic Era (1.15.9)** | Supported from v1.0.0 (Season of Discovery maps are not included) |
| **World of Warcraft: Forever (1.60.1)** | Coming in v1.1.0 (the new 1.60 dungeons are not on the map yet) |
| Other clients (Wrath, Cataclysm Classic) | Not supported |

One download works in all supported clients: Yatlas detects the game version and loads only the map data for that client.

Releases are published on [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/yatlas). Releases older than v0.9.4 (up to 0.9.1 for WoW 5.2) do not work with current clients.

## Maps

| Client | Maps |
|---|---|
| Classic Era | Eastern Kingdoms, Kalimdor |
| World of Warcraft: Forever | Eastern Kingdoms, Kalimdor, Zephras Isle |
| Anniversary (TBC) | Eastern Kingdoms, Kalimdor, Outland |
| Mists of Pandaria Classic | Eastern Kingdoms, Kalimdor, Outland, Northrend, Pandaria, Deepholm, Tol Barad, Isle of Thunder, Darkmoon Island |
| Retail | Eastern Kingdoms (with Quel'Thalas), Kalimdor, Outland, Northrend, Deepholm, Tol Barad, Pandaria, Isle of Thunder, Draenor, Broken Isles, Argus, Zandalar, Kul Tiras, Nazjatar, The Shadowlands, Zereth Mortis, Dragon Isles, The Forbidden Reach, Zaralek Cavern, Emerald Dream, Khaz Algar (surface and underground), Undermine, Siren Isle, K'aresh, Harandar, Voidstorm, Darkmoon Island |

## Usage

Yatlas has two views:

- **Normal view** works much like Atlas: a window you can move around. You can open it in three ways:
  - Click the minimap button.
  - Type `/yatlas`.
  - Press the key binding.
- **Large view** is a bigger, centred map window, shown like the world map. Open it with `/bigyatlas` or its key binding. Press Esc or the binding again to close it.

Both views use the same controls:

- Click and drag to move the map. Use the mouse wheel to zoom.
- Choose a map or jump to a zone from the drop-down menus at the top.
- Hover over a point to see a tooltip.
- **Goto Player** centres the map on your character. Shift-click it to keep following you as you move.
- The button next to the close button switches between the normal and the large view, keeping the current map and position.

In **Options**, you can choose whether the minimap button opens the normal or large view. Right-clicking the minimap button always opens the options.

You can set the key bindings under **Key Bindings → AddOns → Yatlas** (Toggle Yatlas Frame, Toggle Large Yatlas Frame).

### Points on the map

- Towns and landmarks, read live from the game
- Dungeon and raid entrances, using the game's own icons
- Smaller settlements, with localized names
- Flight paths for your faction. Undiscovered ones are dimmed.
- Delve entrances (Retail), including today's bountiful delves.
- Skyriding race start points (Retail).
- Party and raid members

You can turn each type of point on or off from the options menu. Landmarks have a submenu with separate switches for instances, capitals, towns, travel (boats, zeppelins and portals, Retail) and other landmarks.

### Known limitations

- Graveyards are not shown. The client files no longer contain graveyard locations, so this feature stays off until a reliable source is found.
- The old integrations with Gatherer, MapNotes and CT_MapMod are not loaded.
- The game does not report your position inside dungeons and raids, so Yatlas cannot track you there.

## Installation

1. Download the latest release from [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/yatlas) or from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/arithmandar/Yatlas/releases).
2. Extract it into the AddOns folder of your client, for example `World of Warcraft\_retail_\Interface\AddOns\Yatlas\`, `_classic_` (Mists), `_anniversary_` or `_classic_era_`.
3. Restart the game or reload the UI, then enable Yatlas in the AddOns list.

## Repository layout

| Path | Contents |
|---|---|
| `Yatlas.toc` | Addon metadata and load order |
| `Bindings.xml` | Key bindings (must stay in the addon root folder) |
| `Libs/` | `Libs.xml` loads LibStub, CallbackHandler-1.0, LibDataBroker-1.1 and LibDBIcon-1.0; the libraries themselves are fetched by the packager (`.pkgmeta` externals) |
| `Core/` | `Compat.lua` (wrappers for the modern API), `Constants.lua` (client detection `YATLAS_CLIENT`, addon metadata, texture paths, backdrops), `Options.lua` (option defaults, migrations and dialog handlers), `Core.lua` (slash commands and frame switching), `MapFrame.lua` (map drawing and frame logic), `Points.lua` (point framework) |
| `UI/` | Frames built in Lua: `Templates.lua` (frame/button/slider factories, hover tooltip), `Yatlas.lua` (normal and large frames), `OptionsFrame.lua` (options dialog layout), `Button.lua` (minimap button through LibDBIcon-1.0) |
| `Modules/` | Point sets loaded by `Modules/index.xml` (landmarks, flight paths, delves, races, players, ...) |
| `Data/` | `Data.xml` loads `Common.lua` (shared data), one generated `mapdb.lua` + `mapdb2.lua` per client in `ClassicEra/`, `Forever/`, `TBC/`, `Mists/`, `Mainline/` (minimap tiles, map areas, instances, towns, flight paths; each file returns at once on other clients) and `Localize.lua` |
| `Locale/` | UI strings: enUS (default), deDE, esES/esMX, frFR, itIT, koKR, ptBR, ruRU, zhCN, zhTW |
| `Images/` | Addon textures and icons (BLP) |
| `tools/` | Python scripts that regenerate the map data (not included in releases) |
| `Docs/` | Changelog, data sources and the CurseForge description |

## Map data

The map data is generated from the client DB2 tables and WDT files of each supported build, which can be browsed on wago.tools: [1.15.9.70003](https://wago.tools/db2?build=1.15.9.70003), [2.5.6.70006](https://wago.tools/db2?build=2.5.6.70006), [5.5.4.70579](https://wago.tools/db2?build=5.5.4.70579) and [12.1.5.70575](https://wago.tools/db2?build=12.1.5.70575). [`Docs/DataSources.md`](https://github.com/arithmandar/Yatlas/blob/main/Docs/DataSources.md) describes where each table comes from and the API changes. [`tools/README.md`](https://github.com/arithmandar/Yatlas/blob/main/tools/README.md) explains how to regenerate the files in `Data/`.

## License

Yatlas is free software: you can redistribute it and/or modify it under the terms of the
GNU General Public License, version 2, as published by the Free Software Foundation.
It is distributed in the hope that it will be useful, but WITHOUT ANY WARRANTY; without even
the implied warranty of MERCHANTABILITY or FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE. See
[`LICENSE`](https://github.com/arithmandar/Yatlas/blob/main/LICENSE) for the full text.

Yatlas was originally written by Boo Diddly and is maintained by arithmandar.

World of Warcraft and its textures, icons and map data are the property of Blizzard
Entertainment; they are read from the game client at run time and are not covered by this
license.

# Yatlas ChangeLog

### v1.2.2 (Nov. 24, 2026)

- Added an option to open the large view with the minimap button; the normal view remains the default
- Display current transparency and icon size values next to their sliders
- Centralized option defaults, migrations and dialog handlers in `Core\Options.lua`

### v1.2.1 (Nov. 12, 2026)

- Updated LibDataBroker external url

### v1.2.0 (Nov. 11, 2026)

**Minimap button**

- The minimap button is now handled by LibDBIcon-1.0 (with LibDataBroker-1.1), so it follows square and other custom minimap shapes and can be managed by minimap button collector addons
- New icon: `Images\Icons\Yatlas.blp`
- Left-click opens Yatlas, right-click opens the options, drag (left button) moves the button
- The saved button visibility and position are carried over to the new button (`YatlasOptions.Minimap`)
- Also available as a LibDataBroker launcher (`Yatlas`) for broker display addons

### v1.1.2 (Nov. 08, 2026)

- Removed redundant old data

### v1.1.1 (Nov. 07, 2026)

- Added auto-packaging support for WowInterface archives

### v1.1.0 (Nov. 05, 2026)

**World of Warcraft: Forever**

- Yatlas now runs on World of Warcraft: Forever (1.60.1) with Eastern Kingdoms, Kalimdor and
  Zephras Isle, built from the Forever game files
- Instance entrances of the original dungeons and raids, flight paths, capitals and towns
- The new Forever dungeons are not shown yet: the game files have no entrance positions for them

**Internal**

- The frames are now built in Lua (`UI\Templates.lua`, `Yatlas.lua`, `OptionsFrame.lua`, `Button.lua`)
  instead of XML; map tile textures are created on demand; the map frame logic moved to `Core\MapFrame.lua`
- Less work in the background: map point rebuilds caused by game events (area POIs, flight paths,
  loading screens) are combined into one per frame and skipped while the map is closed, then done
  when it opens; atlas lookups are cached; group member icons are only restyled when they change
- The zone drop-down picks the smallest zone under the centre of the view, so it no longer changes
  between sessions where zones overlap
- Mainline / Forever: the "Travel" landmark category is also offered on Forever
- Fixed: icons in the map tooltip (landmarks, flight paths, delves) were drawn larger than their
  line on Retail and ran into the name and the next line; they are now centred in a fixed slot
- Fixed: after hovering a delve or a spot with several landmarks, the next tooltip icons could show
  as a blurry square (the reused tooltip line kept the crop of the previous icon)
- Fixed: hovering the top left corner of the map could list hidden points in the tooltip; group
  member positions could be drawn against the other Yatlas frame
- Fixed: thin lines between map tiles while panning, and stray coloured strips left at the right /
  bottom edge of the view after zooming out. The map is now a grid of full size tiles on a canvas
  that the view clips at its edges, instead of tiles cropped one by one
- Panning is lighter: within one map tile only the canvas moves (tile textures and map points are
  rebuilt only when the view crosses into another tile, zooms or changes map); points at the edge of
  the view are now cut off by the view instead of popping in and out
- Removed the unused MapNotes / GatherMate hooks (the GatherMate one would have broken that addon)
  and unused cursor coordinate code

### v1.0.0 (Oct. 26, 2026)

**One download for every client**

- Yatlas now runs on Retail (12.1.5), Mists of Pandaria Classic (5.5.4), Anniversary (2.5.6) and
  Classic Era (1.15.9). Each client uses map data built from its own game files
- On a client that is not supported, Yatlas shows a short message instead of Lua errors

**Maps**

- Retail: new maps for Draenor, Broken Isles, Argus, Zandalar, Kul Tiras, Nazjatar, The Shadowlands,
  Zereth Mortis, Dragon Isles, The Forbidden Reach, Zaralek Cavern, Emerald Dream, Khaz Algar
  (surface and underground), Undermine, Siren Isle, K'aresh, Harandar, Voidstorm, and Quel'Thalas
  on the Eastern Kingdoms map
- The map menu lists the maps in expansion order
- The map zooms out about four times further, and the mouse wheel and +/- buttons zoom in
  smoother steps
- The empty ocean filler tiles around the maps are gone

**Points on the map**

- Towns and capitals now show on every client, with the same icons as the world map; on Retail,
  capitals use the Alliance and Horde icons
- Retail: delve entrances, including bountiful delves
- Retail: skyriding race start points
- Landmarks can be filtered: instances, capitals, towns, travel (Retail: boats, zeppelins and
  portals) and other landmarks each have their own switch
- Tooltips show an extra line like the world map, for example "Undiscovered Flightpoint"
- Retail: dungeon, raid and flight path icons are sized to match the world map, and undiscovered
  flight paths are easier to see
- Retail: flight paths that depend on your character's progress (for example in Quel'Thalas or
  Teldrassil) only show when the world map shows them too
- The point menu always lists the point types in the same order

**Minimap button**

- New look: the world map icon in a round frame, like other minimap buttons
- Retail: the button circles the minimap correctly again

**Other**

- Yatlas is now licensed under the GNU General Public License, version 2

### v0.9.6 (Oct. 26, 2026)

- Reorganized the addon folders: Core/, Data/, UI/, Modules/ (was sets/), Images/ (was images/)
- Textures converted from TGA to BLP; texture paths now use Images\
- Bindings.xml stays in the addon root folder (WoW only loads it from there)
- New Core/Constants.lua collects the constants: addon metadata, texture paths, coordinate scale,
  frame option defaults and backdrops
- Title, version, author, website and release date now all come from the TOC
  (new ## Author, ## X-Credits for the original author Boo Diddly, and ## X-Date: 2026-11-24T15:55:47Z); the author e-mail field was removed
- Player position uses the game's world map arrow (Interface\WorldMap\WorldMapArrow) and turns
  with the facing (GetPlayerFacing); position and facing update every 0.05 s while Yatlas is open
- Party and raid members use the game's WhiteCircle-RaidBlips dot in class colour
  (Icon-PartyUnit is kept only as a fallback)
- The big frame is now called the "large" frame in the key binding and tooltips (it is not fullscreen),
  in all 10 languages
- New tooltips for the lock/unlock button (shows the current state), the close buttons,
  the Show Points button (bottom right) and the zoom button (bottom left)
- New tooltips for Goto Player (in both frames; also shows when the map is following you)
  and the Options button
- Version text moved left so it no longer overlaps the switch, lock and close buttons
- Fixed: "Outland" was the only continent not localized in the map menu. It used uiMapID 101,
  which does not exist in 5.5.4; Outland is uiMapID 1467 there (987 is an orphan copy outside the
  world map tree). This also fixes the continent-level flight path and landmark lookups for Outland
- Fixed: pressing Esc in the large frame caused ADDON_ACTION_FORBIDDEN (RunBinding() is protected).
  The large frame no longer captures the keyboard; Esc closes it through the game's own panel handling,
  and the toggle and screenshot keys go straight to their normal bindings

### v0.9.5 (Oct. 26, 2026)
